text:
The squirrel runs.

The squirrel flies.

The squirrel jumps

like a little madcap.

—Mother, does the squirrel

not go to school?

—Come, little squirrel,

I have a cage

that is very pretty.

—No, I prefer

my tree trunk

and my hole.

translation.title: The Squirrel
translation.editorial_note: The translation preserves the children's poem simplicity and the squirrel's free answer.
